name: helix-cc
description: Helix delivery, TDD, reconnaissance, research, review, and pre-PR loops mapped onto Claude Code dynamic workflows.

scripts.ci: npm run graph:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:graph
scripts.test:graph: HELIX_CC_WORKFLOW_MODE=graph node --test tests/workflow.test.mjs tests/implement-review-workflow.test.mjs tests/tdd-fix-workflow.test.mjs tests/scout-workflow.test.mjs tests/research-workflow.test.mjs tests/ship-pre-pr-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run ci && claude plugin validate --strict .
